note: The AUTHORING queue of the [lean-hammer] batch ride (PLAN_HAMMER.md H1.3). Each candidate is PROPOSED FgReflect module text -- definitions and theorems -- elaborated by the lane spliced inside `namespace FgReflect` after the committed tools/FgReflect.lean, exactly the way run/reflect_shadow.py composes its probes. `declares` names the declarations the candidate claims to introduce; the ride FAILS a candidate whose claimed names are absent from its own text, so a proof that renames its own theorem can never pass on a name it did not introduce. A candidate is a PROPOSAL and never a slice edit: adopting a passed one is an ordinary authored edit in a later session, and tools/FgReflect.lean has no write path from this file.
honesty: A verdict row is lane evidence about ELABORATION, never a certificate and never a fidelity verdict. sorryAx in the audited axiom set is never a pass -- a candidate that merely elaborates with a hole is a well-formed hole, not a proof -- and audit silence fails CLOSED. This channel iterates at a SESSION BOUNDARY per ride, one round-trip per push and not per minute; it is the slow second route to tower-class work when tools/lean_env_probe.py reads lean-absent, never a replacement for a local toolchain and never a softening of PLAN_FRAGMENT 3.1 rule 3, whose lane verdict remains final.
